scene: Pocketing glowing thread, three transit gates open outside.
picture: Along a level stone terrace, an open brass spiral lift stands on the far left. The woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat, satchel bulging, stands at centre facing right. Further right rests a yellow mountain cable tram. At the far right, a green river barge floats beside a wooden dock.
shown: a caged brass spiral lift standing open on the far left
a yellow mountain cable tram parked on tracks on the right
a green wooden river barge moored on water at far right

variants.scene: Silver thread in hand, you find bustling paths waiting along the dusky harbour.
Holding the shining spool, you wonder if {quest} waits beyond the misty water.
Lamps glow warm above the dock as three exciting journeys call to you.
